Quality control warnings and issues for cattle feeding and drinking data

Source: R/data.R
warning.Rd

A dataset containing all warnings and issues identified during quality control procedures applied to feeding and drinking data. This dataset is generated by the qc() function and updated by the feed_water_summary() function with additional warnings related to daily intake patterns.

Usage

warning

Format

A tibble with one row per day and the following columns:

date

character, calendar date of the records in "YYYY-MM-DD" format

total_cows

integer, number of unique cows detected on that day

missing_cow

character, "Yes" if expected number of cows is not present, NA otherwise

double_detection_bins

character, semicolon-separated list of bin IDs where double detection issues occurred (when the same cow is detected at different bins at the same time)

negative_visit_bins

character, semicolon-separated list of bin IDs with negative duration or intake values

cows_disappeared_after_noon

character, semicolon-separated list of cow IDs that did not appear after 12:00 noon

bins_never_visited

character, semicolon-separated list of bin IDs that had no visits

bins_low_traffic

character, semicolon-separated list of bin IDs with fewer than the threshold number of visits

long_dur_feeder

character, semicolon-separated list of feeding visits with abnormally long durations

large_intake_feed_visit

character, semicolon-separated list of feeding visits with abnormally large intake amounts

low_daily_feed_intake_cows

character, semicolon-separated list of cow IDs with daily feed intake below the threshold

high_daily_feed_intake_cows

character, semicolon-separated list of cow IDs with daily feed intake above the threshold

feed_add_time_no_found

character, times when feed addition could not be identified

long_dur_drinker

character, semicolon-separated list of drinking visits with abnormally long durations

large_intake_water_visit

character, semicolon-separated list of drinking visits with abnormally large intake amounts

low_daily_water_intake_cows

character, semicolon-separated list of cow IDs with daily water intake below the threshold

high_daily_water_intake_cows

character, semicolon-separated list of cow IDs with daily water intake above the threshold

Source

Generated from quality control checks on all_fed and all_wat

Details

This dataset documents all quality control issues found when processing raw feeding and drinking data. It is initially generated by the qc() function which identifies issues like double detections, negative intake values, and abnormal durations. It is further updated by the feed_water_summary() function to include warnings about daily intake patterns such as abnormally high or low daily feed and water consumption. The warning dataset is essential for data validation and can help identify potential equipment malfunctions, animal health issues, or data collection problems.

Examples

# Check which days had bins with negative values
warning[!is.na(warning$negative_visit_bins), c("date", "negative_visit_bins")]
#> # A tibble: 3 × 2
#>   date       negative_visit_bins
#>   <chr>      <chr>              
#> 1 2020-10-31 6; 12; 13          
#> 2 2020-11-01 6; 12; 13; 30      
#> 3 2020-11-02 13; 30
